sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops the keyboard sending typed text, voice input, usage events, device details, install attribution and crash reports to Desh Keyboard, Meta and Firebase.
Unlocks Premium, which removes promoted app suggestions and the Desh Keyboard signature added to messages and shared stickers.
